1.

For Israel Thou didst formerly Thyself call: "I am," And still Thou art the same, But also our beloved Father. Thy holy name, Thy open arms, Thy faithful, tender love Our refuge now is, Jehovah, who didst call Thyself In former time: "I am."

2.

Our Father of Jesus Christ, Our God from eternity, Thou for us through the wilderness With grace and faithfulness. With tenderness sees Thine eye below And shields us from dangers, Of which we know nothing. So lovingly Thou leadest us Home to Thy glory.
